topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing for the lecture by recapping foundational concepts and outlining the learning objectives concerning cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignant transformation is driven by Darwinian clonal selection of genetic mutations alongside non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies, the cell of origin, and cancer stem cell dynamics influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and the Evolutionary Framework of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how microenvironmental cues and inflammatory promoters drive tumor growth, how these cellular interactions are experimentally investigated, and how they synthesize into a unified evolutionary model.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing by concluding the presentation and previewing the next lecture on cancer therapy.
